`interface IThreadBridge`<br/>
**Extends:** [`IBridge`](/reference/bridges/ibridge/)<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`DirectThreadBridge`](/reference/bridges/directthreadbridge/), [`FrameThreadBridge`](/reference/bridges/framethreadbridge/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.thread` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IThreadBridge.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/thread/IThreadBridge.java)

The bridge that tells JOID which thread draws and runs the work of other threads on it.

## Description

Every entry point of JOID that must run on the render thread goes through [`ThreadUtils.runOnRenderThread`](/reference/utilities/threadutils/#ThreadUtils-method-runOnRenderThread), which calls this bridge.
[Write your own when the engine owns the render thread](/build/bridges/thread/#write-your-own-when-the-engine-owns-the-render-thread) hands the work to the queue of an engine that draws on a thread of its own.
